ideas.pitch: A localized predictive analytics engine forecasting severe respiratory illness spikes in Kanpur based on real-time AQI data, industrial output metrics, and Poisson regression models.
ideas.title: Kanpur-Pulse: Urban Air Quality & Health Incident Forecasting
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning formula of rigorous statistical forecasting and directly targets an urgent environmental and public health reality in Kanpur that the judges face daily.

ideas.pitch: A decentralized peer-to-peer marketplace for college students featuring automated USDC escrow payments and reputation tracking tailored for campus exchanges.
ideas.title: CampusCart: Autonomous Student Micro-Marketplace with Escrow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies a proven autonomous transaction pattern and solves an immediate, tangible campus commerce pain point for students and organizers.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent platform for hostel mess committees that personalizes daily student nutrition requirements while tracking and minimizing institutional food wastage.
ideas.title: MessMate: AI-Powered Mess Menu Nutrition & Waste Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly attacks a ubiquitous college pain point with localized health tech value, echoing past nutrition hackathon winners.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite imagery analysis tool that detects unauthorized industrial expansion and environmental regulation violations around Kanpur's manufacturing belts.
ideas.title: ComplianceEye: Satellite-Based Industrial Zone Monitoring
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates complex geospatial data processing combined with tangible social and regulatory impact, mirroring high-scoring technical entries.

ideas.pitch: An explainable risk-scoring platform designed for local fintech apps to instantly flag suspicious peer-to-peer transfer chains using graph intelligence and LightGBM.
ideas.title: FinGuard: Micro-Transactions AML & Risk Detection Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings rigorous, production-grade financial security patterns into the Open Innovation and FinTech track with transparent model explainability.
